name: Dune
summary: Onchain analytics from Dune: results of saved SQL queries over blockchain data, fetched as the latest run or by running the query.

api_key.description: A Dune API key with at least Read scope (dune.com settings > API). Sent in the X-Dune-Api-Key header.

notes: API access needs a trial or paid plan; free accounts are view-only.
Credits: runs are charged for compute used (by engine tier); fetching results is charged per MB exported (2 credits/MB on Plus, 10 on Analyst).
Rate limits on Plus: 70 requests/minute for runs, 200/minute for reads; Enterprise from 350 and 1000.
Results stored over 32 GB are truncated; ask with allow_partial_results to read them.

endpoints.name: Get a query's latest result
endpoints.summary: Rows of the latest finished run of a saved query (public or yours), from the app or the API.

query_id.description: Saved query ID, the number in dune.com/queries/<id>.

limit.description: Rows to return; with offset for paging. Not with sample_count.

columns.description: Comma-separated columns to return; fewer columns cost fewer credits.

filters.description: SQL WHERE-like row filter, e.g. block_time > '2024-01-01'. Not with sample_count.

sort_by.description: SQL ORDER BY-like expression, e.g. amount_usd desc.

sample_count.description: Return a random uniform sample of this many rows.

allow_partial_results.description: Return the truncated part of a result over the 32 GB storage limit instead of failing.

notes: Does not run the query, but costs credits per MB of result returned.
404 when the query's SQL changed since its last run: run it with dune.query.execute first.
Page with limit and offset; the response carries next_offset while rows remain.

endpoints.name: Run a saved query
endpoints.summary: Starts a run of a saved query, optionally with parameter values, and returns an execution ID.

query_parameters.description: Parameter values by name, e.g. {"days": 7}; unset ones use their defaults.

performance.description: Engine tier: small, medium or large; default the query's tier.

notes: Starts a billed job: credits are charged for the compute the run uses, even if the results are never fetched.
A read sent as POST: it runs the saved SQL and changes nothing in it.
Poll dune.execution.status, then read dune.execution.results. Prefer dune.query.latest_result when a recent run is good enough.

endpoints.name: Check a query run's status
endpoints.summary: State of an execution (pending, executing, completed, failed...), with timing and credits used.
notes: Done when state is QUERY_STATE_COMPLETED; also QUERY_STATE_FAILED, _CANCELED, _EXPIRED or _COMPLETED_PARTIAL.

endpoints.name: Get a query run's results
endpoints.summary: Rows of one execution, once it has completed.

limit.description: Rows to return; with offset for paging. Not with sample_count.

columns.description: Comma-separated columns to return; fewer columns cost fewer credits.

filters.description: SQL WHERE-like row filter, e.g. block_time > '2024-01-01'. Not with sample_count.

sort_by.description: SQL ORDER BY-like expression, e.g. amount_usd desc.

sample_count.description: Return a random uniform sample of this many rows.

allow_partial_results.description: Return the truncated part of a result over the 32 GB storage limit instead of failing.

notes: Costs credits per MB of result returned.

endpoints.name: Read a saved query
endpoints.summary: SQL text, parameters, name, tags and state of a saved query.
notes: Queries endpoints need the Plus or Enterprise plan. Private queries are readable only with their owner's key.
